description: Frontier-paydown chain for the σ_shell (Term 7) closed-form coefficient at A = 2: derives C_{(3,2,1)}(q) from Hecke energy + Schur–Weyl + Wigner-2 with NO SCRIPT_CITED steps — fully trusted modulo AXIOMs and the still-conjectural classifications (MarkovWeight.staircase, Wigner2Coefficient, ShadowPriceStaircase) marked qou:STUB:.  The OUTER α_5 empirical fit (−4.2 × 10^5 MeV) is the remaining frontier debt for σ_shell at A ≥ 4.

steps.name: Hecke energy h = q − q^{-1}
steps.operation: Hecke energy axiom: each braid generator σ_i carries the relation σ_i² = (q − q^{-1}) σ_i + 1; the prefactor h := q − q^{-1} is the per-crossing energy scale (CLAUDE.md §7a).

steps.name: q-integer [k]_q := (q^k − q^{-k})/(q − q^{-1})
steps.operation: Define [k]_q via Hecke energy h: [k]_q = (q^k − q^{-k}) / h.  At q → 1 reduces to k.  Same definition as in the schur-weyl-weight-3 chain.

steps.name: Wedderburn decomposition of H_6(q) — height-6 sector
steps.operation: H_6(q) ≅ ⊕_{λ ⊢ 6} M_{f_λ}(K(q)).  Height filter height(λ) = 6 picks out the unique staircase partition (3, 2, 1) of 6 (the only partition of 6 with all rows of distinct length and maximal height).

steps.name: Wedderburn weight w_{(3,2,1)}(q)
steps.operation: By Schur–Weyl duality the Markov-Wedderburn weight of λ = (3, 2, 1) ⊢ 6 is w_λ(q) = dim_q(λ)² / [6]_q!, where dim_q is the q-deformed Young-frame dimension.  Hook lengths for the staircase are {5,3,1; 3,1; 1}; dim_q((3,2,1)) = [6]_q! / ([5]_q [3]_q^2 [1]_q^3) = [6]_q! / ([5]_q [3]_q^2).

steps.name: Wigner-2 trace identity τ_{(3,2,1)} = h/2
steps.operation: Per `prop:wigner-2-coefficient` (the Wigner-2 closed form), self-conjugate partitions admit the trace-per-dimension identity τ_λ(σ_g) = h/2 for the canonical generator σ_g.  (3, 2, 1) is the smallest self-conjugate staircase, so τ_{(3,2,1)} = h/2.

steps.name: Closed form C_{(3,2,1)}(q) — staircase shadow price
steps.operation:
C_λ(q) := w_λ(q) · τ_λ(σ_g) is the BW shadow-price coefficient (`prop:mass-coefficient-shadow-price`).  Substitute w_{(3,2,1)} and τ_{(3,2,1)} = h/2; collect q-integer factors:
  C_{(3,2,1)}(q) = [2]_q · [4]_q · [6]_q · h / (2 · [3]_q³ · [5]_q).
(The combinatorial reduction from [6]_q! / ([5]_q² · [3]_q⁴) · h/2 to the stated form uses [k]_q recurrences and simplification.)

steps.name: Evaluate C_{(3,2,1)}(q_0) at q_0 = 1.1099785956
steps.operation: Substitute q := q_0 ≈ 1.110 into the closed form; evaluate at 60 dps mpmath.  Result agrees with the paper's quoted ≈ 0.0375.
steps.notes: COMPUTATIONAL leaf — bare arithmetic.  Reproduces the paper's `≈ 0.0375` quote in shell-correction-term-seven.md.  The OUTER α_5 normalisation (≈ −4.2 × 10^5 MeV per the diagnostic fit) is NOT yet derived; it remains a separate computational debt tracked under `higher-a-shell-diagnostic.witness.json`.
